messages.content: You are Player A in a single Trust Game. You start with a bonus of 0.50 US dollars and choose exactly one transfer X: 0.05 or 0.25 dollars. You keep 0.50-X. The transfer is multiplied by four, so Players B and C together receive 4X. They can return half of that amount (Y=2X), or none (Y=0). Your final bonus is 0.50-X+Y; B and C together retain 4X-Y. If you send 0.05, your final bonus is 0.55 with a half return or 0.45 with no return. If you send 0.25, your final bonus is 0.75 with a half return or 0.25 with no return. B and C are real participants at University College London, not MTurk workers. Their choices have already been recorded, and your choice will be matched to those recorded decisions. Your worker ID will not be revealed to them. You are told whether B and C discussed and jointly agreed on their response, or could not communicate and made their responses independently. This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Reply only with 0.05 or 0.25, in US dollars, without a currency symbol or explanation.

This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Reply only with 0.05 or 0.25, in US dollars, without a currency symbol or explanation.

The transfer is multiplied by four, so Players B and C together receive 4X. They can return half of that amount (Y=2X), or none (Y=0). Your final bonus is 0.50-X+Y; B and C together retain 4X-Y. If you send 0.05, your final bonus is 0.55 with a half return or 0.45 with no return. If you send 0.25, your final bonus is 0.75 with a half return or 0.25 with no return. B and C are real participants at University College London, not MTurk workers. Their choices have already been recorded, and your choice will be matched to those recorded decisions. Your worker ID will not be revealed to them. You are told whether B and C discussed and jointly agreed on their response, or could not communicate and made their responses independently. This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Give the confidence rating from 1 to 5: 1 = very skeptical that the other player was real, 5 = very confident that the other player was real. Reply only with that integer. Intermediate points are numbered without verbal anchors.

This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Give the confidence rating from 1 to 5: 1 = very skeptical that the other player was real, 5 = very confident that the other player was real. Reply only with that integer. Intermediate points are numbered without verbal anchors.

If you send 0.05, your final bonus is 0.55 with a half return or 0.45 with no return. If you send 0.25, your final bonus is 0.75 with a half return or 0.25 with no return. B and C are real participants at University College London, not MTurk workers. Their choices have already been recorded, and your choice will be matched to those recorded decisions. Your worker ID will not be revealed to them. You are told whether B and C discussed and jointly agreed on their response, or could not communicate and made their responses independently. This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Give the confidence rating from 1 to 5: 1 = very skeptical that the other player was real, 5 = very confident that the other player was real. Reply only with that integer. Intermediate points are numbered without verbal anchors.

This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Reply only with 0.05 or 0.25, in US dollars, without a currency symbol or explanation.

B and C are real participants at University College London, not MTurk workers. Their choices have already been recorded, and your choice will be matched to those recorded decisions. This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Give the confidence rating from 1 to 5: 1 = very skeptical that the other player was real, 5 = very confident that the other player was real. Reply only with that integer. Intermediate points are numbered without verbal anchors.

Reply only with 0.05 or 0.25, in US dollars, without a currency symbol or explanation.

The transfer is multiplied by four, so Players B and C together receive 4X. They can return half of that amount (Y=2X), or none (Y=0). Your final bonus is 0.50-X+Y; B and C together retain 4X-Y. If you send 0.05, your final bonus is 0.55 with a half return or 0.45 with no return. If you send 0.25, your final bonus is 0.75 with a half return or 0.25 with no return. B and C are real participants at University College London, not MTurk workers. Their choices have already been recorded, and your choice will be matched to those recorded decisions. Your worker ID will not be revealed to them. You are told whether B and C discussed and jointly agreed on their response, or could not communicate and made their responses independently. This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Give the confidence rating from 1 to 5: 1 = very skeptical that the other player was real, 5 = very confident that the other player was real. Reply only with that integer. Intermediate points are numbered without verbal anchors.

Reply only with 0.05 or 0.25, in US dollars, without a currency symbol or explanation.

This information is specified in your current context. After your transfer you see which return they chose. The lab states that it does not use deception and all players are real. Give the confidence rating from 1 to 5: 1 = very skeptical that the other player was real, 5 = very confident that the other player was real. Reply only with that integer.
